description: This file defines classes and functions for managing trip data layers on a map, including handling trip routes, markers, paths, and points with update and rendering logic, as part of a mapping widget in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbTripDataItem
classes.description: Represents a trip data item on the map, managing route points, markers, paths, and their updates.

classes.name: TbTripsDataLayer
classes.description: Manages multiple trip data items, handling data preparation, updates, styling, and interaction for trip routes on the map.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the trip data item with new route data, recalculating route, marker, and points.

methods.name: updateLatestData
methods.description: Updates the latest data for the trip item and refreshes appearance.

methods.name: updateAppearance
methods.description: Refreshes visual appearance of the trip route, marker, and points.

methods.name: updateCurrentTime
methods.description: Updates the current position based on the current map time.

methods.name: invalidateCoordinates
methods.description: Recalculates route data and updates visual elements.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the trip item and its elements from the map.

methods.name: calculateAnchors
methods.description: Calculates anchor points for snapping based on trip route data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes route, marker, and points for the trip.

methods.name: createMarker
methods.description: Creates and adds a marker to the map.

methods.name: createPath
methods.description: Creates the route polyline and decorator.

methods.name: updatePath
methods.description: Updates the route polyline and decorator.

methods.name: updatePoints
methods.description: Creates, updates, or removes route points on the map.

methods.name: updatePathAppearance
methods.description: Updates the style of the route path.

methods.name: updateMarkerLocation
methods.description: Sets marker position based on data.

methods.name: prepareTripRouteData
methods.description: Prepares route data with interpolation and rotation calculations.

methods.name: updateCurrentPosition
methods.description: Updates current position data based on map time.
